correctness.rationale: The local rewrite preserves first two letters, total parity and order/parities of symbol first appearances. Each attainable signature has a representative of length at most seven. All 354 representative-by-letter right transitions were certified by actual finite rewrite connectivity among every ternary word of length at most fourteen (7,174,453 vertices, 8,370,198 edges), with executable code supplied. Right compatibility of the signature plus the transition lemma yields an induction for all finite words. A separate exact signature count gives 118 global classes and 1,3,9,21,39,51,57 at lengths zero through six, stabilizing at 57. The finite certificate alone is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of a rewriting quotient arising from length-two palindromic DNA-style duplication, rather than an arbitrary finite sample. It gives a first-two-letter and first-occurrence parity signature, computes the exact quotient size 118 and stable exact-length count 57, and yields a linear-time equivalence decision algorithm. The third first-occurrence information is genuinely new relative to the binary restriction. Nothing is inferred about forward-descendant intersection or optimal code size.
